privacy.fixture_strategy: synthetic objects with real Bitrix IDs and structural fields; text replaced by stable hashes or placeholder UTF-8; FILES urls use fake _efd of equal length

shared_fixtures.source: audit deal 18733 snapshots A/B/Z and stage 1.5 live rounds
audit C_018 vs Z object set; FILES urls differ but are excluded from canonical fingerprints

tests.name: identical Bitrix payload at different observed_at
tests.fixture: F_EMAIL_627981 same payload and URL; observed_at=A then observed_at=B
tests.input: normalize(X, observed_at=A); merge(empty, X); normalize(X, observed_at=B); merge(result, X)
tests.expected_canonical: one entity activity:627981; semantic_fingerprint SAME; raw_fingerprint SAME
tests.expected_delta: first merge NEW; second merge entries empty (UNCHANGED, omitted)

tests.name: email FILES _efd token rotation
tests.fixture: F_EMAIL_627981 url_variant_a vs url_variant_b; same file ids
tests.input: two list payloads, only FILES[].url._efd differs
tests.expected_canonical: semantic_fingerprint SAME; raw_fingerprint SAME; file_ids identical

tests.name: file order does not matter
tests.expected_canonical: file_ids sorted; semantic_fingerprint SAME; raw_fingerprint SAME

tests.name: recording file replacement
tests.input: activity 663127 file_ids [1012207] then [1012215]; ORIGIN_ID same; LAST_UPDATED changed
tests.expected_canonical: same key activity:663127; subtype call; semantic_fingerprint changed; file_ids after=[1012215]
tests.expected_delta: UPDATED_MEANINGFUL; changed_semantic_fields includes file_ids; not NEW

tests.name: call completion
tests.input: COMPLETED N→Y, STATUS 1→2, LAST_UPDATED changed, FILES empty both, END_TIME unchanged
tests.expected_canonical: same key activity:663125; semantic changed on completed+status; missed_call true both
tests.expected_delta: UPDATED_MEANINGFUL; changed_semantic_fields [completed, status]; last_updated is metadata only

tests.name: only LAST_UPDATED changed
tests.fixture: synthetic from T2 of 663125 with LAST_UPDATED bumped and semantic fields copied

tests.name: deal DATE_MODIFY only
tests.input: DATE_MODIFY and MODIFY_BY_ID change; stage/amount/assigned unchanged
tests.expected_delta: UPDATED_TECHNICAL on deal:18733; changed_semantic_fields []; changed_metadata_fields [date_modify, modify_by_id]

tests.name: new email
tests.input: merge previous state without 662983 with batch containing it
tests.expected_delta: NEW; before null; after semantic; not revision

tests.name: email maturation
tests.expected_delta: UPDATED_MEANINGFUL; not NEW; changed_semantic_fields includes completed and/or status

tests.name: repeated incremental does not duplicate
tests.fixture: C_007 email plus second incremental that returns the same activity again (overlap)

tests.name: incomplete incremental response does not delete
tests.fixture: state with activities A,B,C; incremental batch only B updated
tests.input: successful incremental list that omits A and C
tests.expected_canonical: A,B,C all remain; B maybe revised
tests.expected_delta: no REMOVED; A and C have no entries

tests.name: failed source keeps previous state
tests.fixture: good state then activities ok=false empty items
tests.expected_canonical: entities identical to S; source_status.activities failed/stale
tests.expected_delta: no entity NEW/UPDATED from the failed source; no wipe

tests.name: FULL vs accumulated incremental semantic convergence
tests.input: build canonical from accumulated C_018 bundle and from Z FULL bundle
tests.expected_canonical: same entity keys; same aggregate semantic_fingerprint; same aggregate raw_fingerprint; email file_ids match
tests.expected_delta: compare(C018, Z) entries EMPTY when the real Bitrix state is identical

tests.name: list vs get must not become canonical source
tests.fixture: stage 1.5 email 627981 list has COMMUNICATIONS, get omits them
tests.expected_canonical: engine consumes list; get-only fixture is not a merge input
tests.expected_delta: n/a — guard test that activity source is crm.activity.list

tests.name: subtype is not identity
tests.input: same ID across in-progress and completed
tests.expected_canonical: key remains activity:663125; subtype remains call

tests.name: name/size/type on FILES ignored until proven
tests.fixture: synthetic FILES with extra name/size that later change while id stays
